criteria.requirement: Preserve original requirements and completed history; amend only affected facts.
criteria.pass_when: Original sources remain readable and completed movement work remains historical; obstacle work is pending.
criteria.fail_when: Replacing the original request or reopening completed stages loses traceability.

criteria.requirement: Explain behavior and consequential design choices using existing code.
criteria.pass_when: Reuses pose/command model and explains membership lookup and failure-state ownership with a blocked-move example.
criteria.fail_when: Invents a new navigation framework or omits unchanged pose, making the change unsafe or unnecessarily broad.

criteria.requirement: Plan coherent outcomes, dependencies and meaningful acceptance.
criteria.pass_when: A future implementer can verify blocking, later commands and existing turns; boundaries explain why work is grouped.
criteria.fail_when: A function/test census or duplicated execution narration obscures outcomes, or no acceptance catches state mutation.

criteria.requirement: Keep design/planning distinct from implementation and review acceptance.
criteria.pass_when: Changes documents only and distinguishes observed baseline checks from proposed verification and pending review.
criteria.fail_when: Implements the feature or asserts unperformed checks/reviews, misrepresenting readiness.

criteria.requirement: Phase 02 retains the newly authorized YAML and large-list scope.
criteria.pass_when: Revises the earlier design for pre-movement validation and memory-backed lookup; both original and new requests survive.
criteria.fail_when: Rejects YAML merely because it was out of scope in phase 01, or silently drops scale/validation requirements.

criteria.requirement: Phase 02 makes parsing, lookup and validation decisions assessable.
criteria.pass_when: Explains expected lookup cost and memory cost, structure/type validation before use, and consequences of duplicate keys, bool-as-int or malformed coordinates; unresolved policies remain explicit.
criteria.fail_when: Requires or bans a custom loader by fiat, adds unexplained stricter policy, or permits partially valid input to move before validation.

criteria.requirement: A new reader can identify the change, main choice/consequence and next implementation outcome from the actual document beginnings.
criteria.pass_when: The reader correctly identifies YAML starting pose plus large occupied input, pre-movement validation and lookup tradeoff, and the next increment with acceptance; answers are supported by the actual exposed document beginnings, not guesses. Full detail remains navigable.
criteria.fail_when: The reader must guess or cannot locate the change, consequence or next outcome, contradicts the contract, or the main document requires searching through implementation/test inventories. Correctness inferred from other full files does not repair a failed first-screen probe.

criteria.requirement: Reach the requested usable outcome with proportionate time and context; inspect the complete invocation trace, not only the final document.
criteria.pass_when: Concludes when the requested operation is sufficient, with investigation, rewriting, review and checks proportionate to the task scope, uncertainty and actual policy. Incidental local navigation or verification without a material effect on completion, context or maintenance is advisory. Further substantial work addresses a material unknown, changed evidence or actual policy. Records cover invocation through usable final response; task-supplied deadlines apply. Required fixture phases/gates and necessary failure retention remain valid. With no deadline or justified comparison, a process pass does not establish acceptable latency or a speed gain.
criteria.fail_when: Trace demonstrates material unnecessary work through unrelated bulk reading, unnecessary whole-document rewrites, loss/replay of completed work after compaction, cosmetic review cycles or unchanged full checks repeated without cause. Identify the operation and its material consequence for completion, context or maintenance relative to the task; small repetitions may accumulate into a material burden. A supplied deadline is exceeded, or output/one run is used to claim unproved speed. Missing/truncated trace or incomplete invocation is inconclusive only when it prevents deciding. A retained trace proving material unnecessary work or elapsed time already beyond a supplied deadline still fails. Compaction, length or elapsed time alone is not a failure without its relevant condition.
